name: +500 Cross-Sport Parlay

legs.reasoning: PropFinder model projects Tulsa +3.7 with 58% cover probability and identifies a 3.3-point edge on the +7 line. The model sees value in the inflated spread, as Tulsa (3-0, ranked 67th) has exceeded expectations with a 2.2 rating while Arkansas (1-2, ranked 66th) sits at 2.9. Market appears to overvalue Arkansas' home advantage. Getting 7.5 provides additional cushion in what projects as a one-possession game.

PropFinder identifies significant edge with Troy projected at -0.6 (effectively pick'em) while getting +2.5. The model shows 58% cover probability and 3.6-point edge. Troy (2-1, ranked 96th) rates slightly ahead of Utah State (0-3, ranked 111th). Utah State has struggled defensively, ranking 108th, while Troy presents offensive balance. Getting plus money at +100 on FD provides additional value in a competitive Sun Belt vs Pac-12 matchup.

PropFinder model projects Texas A&M +5.5 with 57% cover probability, identifying 3.0-point edge at +8. Both teams rank in top 17 nationally (A&M 17th, LSU 11th) but A&M's defensive ranking (#3 nationally at +11.9) gives them ability to keep this competitive. LSU dropped 35.6 points week-over-week in power rating after home loss. A&M has shown defensive resilience despite offensive struggles. Getting 8.5 in SEC matchup between quality opponents provides value.
